note: One rubric for every candidate type, built the same way as Build Day drop 4's. Scores are decision support for a human reviewer, never a pass/fail verdict.

criteria.title: Connect it to the work
criteria.description: Turns a vague ticket into a clear problem: asks what changed, who is affected, and what working looks like, then picks a first check.

levels.1: Guesses a fix without asking anything
levels.2: Asks something, but no clear problem or first check
levels.4: Clear problem, sharp questions, scope of impact and a first check

criteria.followUp: Ask which single question would most change what they do next.

criteria.title: Judge the output
criteria.description: Spots that a suggested fix weakens security, explains the risk, and gives the safe path from the runbook.

levels.2: Hesitates but does not say why
levels.3: Rejects it and gives the safe path
levels.4: Rejects it, explains the risk, gives the safe path and flags the source

criteria.followUp: Show them a second unsafe suggestion and ask what check would have caught both.

criteria.title: Own the result
criteria.description: When a fix it closed breaks something else: reopens, rolls back, tells the people affected, and changes the process.

levels.1: Blames the user or the tool
levels.3: Rolls back and tells the people affected
levels.4: All of that, plus what changes next time

criteria.followUp: Ask them to write the two-line update they would send the affected floor.
